name: cx-goal-many-rules
task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Whenever you are holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards. Then pick up the box in the other room.
texts: Before the agent takes the door key, the blocking ball must have been moved away from the door.
The agent must take the door key at some point.
The agent should try not to lose the key while the door is still closed.
Whenever the agent is holding the door key, the door should be open at that moment or opened afterwards.
The agent must pick up the target box in the other room.
